title: Base Chain Abstraction
summary: This module defines the abstract base class for all chains, providing a foundational structure for sequential operations, input/output handling, state management, and observability within the LangChain framework.

nodes.label: Define Base Chain Structure
nodes.title: Base Chain
nodes.description: Abstract base class for creating structured sequences of operations, providing core execution logic, input/output handling, and integration points for memory and callbacks.

nodes.label: Manage Chain State
nodes.title: Base Memory
nodes.description: Handles loading and saving conversational context and other stateful information for the chain, enabling persistent interactions.

nodes.label: Handle Callbacks & Events
nodes.title: Callback Manager
nodes.description: Manages and dispatches events to registered callback handlers during chain execution for logging, tracing, and monitoring purposes.

nodes.label: Enable Runnable Serialization
nodes.title: Runnable Serializable
nodes.description: Provides serialization capabilities and defines the runnable interface for the chain, allowing it to be part of the LangChain Expression Language (LCEL).

nodes.label: Validate Data Schemas
nodes.title: Pydantic BaseModel
nodes.description: Used for defining and validating input and output schemas for the chain, ensuring data consistency and type safety.

nodes.label: Receive External Input
nodes.title: External Input
nodes.description: Represents the initial data provided to the chain for processing, typically a dictionary of parameters.

nodes.label: Produce Final Output
nodes.title: Final Output
nodes.description: Represents the processed data returned by the chain after its execution, also typically a dictionary.

groups.label: Core Chain Logic
groups.title: Core Chain Logic
groups.description: Encapsulates the fundamental execution flow and structure of a chain.

groups.label: State & Observability
groups.title: State & Observability
groups.description: Components responsible for managing the chain's state and providing monitoring capabilities.

groups.label: Data Interface & Validation
groups.title: Data Interface & Validation
groups.description: Handles the input and output data flow, including schema definition and validation.

groups.label: Framework Integration
groups.title: Framework Integration
groups.description: Provides the necessary interfaces for the chain to integrate with the broader LangChain framework.
